campaign: SHINE/ISWAT/ESWW SEP Model Validation Challenge (2021 pilot event set)
product: GOES Proton Measurements / Standard Input Parameters
observation_dataset: GOES-13 corrected integral proton fluxes as distributed/processed by the CCMC SEP Model Validation Challenge

target_channels.table: GOES Proton Measurements for >10 MeV, 10 pfu Threshold
GOES Proton Measurements for >100 MeV, 1 pfu Threshold

table_version: updated 2021-04-29 on CCMC Model Input Parameters page
observation_method: CCMC event quantities calculated from GOES observations with OpSEP. The code applies the >10 MeV/10 pfu and >100 MeV/1 pfu event definitions and reports threshold crossing, maximum peak flux/time, end time, duration, and fluence.
auxiliary_observed_inputs: GOES X-ray flare onset/peak/end times from the Model Input Parameters page
NOAA/CCMC/DONKI forecaster CME time at 21.5 Rs and 3-D CME speed from the Model Input Parameters page
figure_location: Per-event CCMC pages, GOES Proton Measurements section. The website plots are unnumbered; the integral-flux threshold panels and adjacent tables show the event quantities. Numeric values in srcSEP are transcribed from the tables, not digitized from figures.
figure_number: not applicable: CCMC web figures are unnumbered
transcription: Rows transcribed from the official >10 MeV/10 pfu and >100 MeV/1 pfu tables; N/A threshold crossings are preserved as non-crossings.
raw_data_limitation: This pilot commits CCMC-derived event quantities rather than raw NOAA/NCEI GOES telemetry files; therefore no raw NOAA file/dataset identifier is claimed by this case.
notes: This is the nine-event SHINE/ISWAT pilot, not the full 15–30 event/non-event EV01 campaign requested by the implementation plan. The current CLEAR benchmark should be used to expand the cohort when archived locally.
